en-us:
More responsive video editing.

- Modified preview avoids uploading the same decoded frame repeatedly.
- Playback and ruler scrubbing move the playhead without repeatedly redrawing every track.
- Ruler scrubbing combines pending seeks and retains the exact final frame on release.
- Drag a yellow marker on the ruler to move it in one undoable edit.
- High-resolution footage and complex effects remain dependent on your device. Generate a proxy for demanding footage.
